notes.title: Storm the Swan - Version 1.5ca - Engine Updates - Autosave fixes
notes.content:
Thanks to everyone who has helped support 'Storm the Swan'.  The project is part of a long line of shorter games that I've been making for the last few years, especially in the horror genre.  

I've learned so much every time I make a new one, and I hope you all stick around for new projects.

I've recently announced a collection of Horror Games I've made coming out real soon.

And, of course, my larger project, 'Date Time', a retro-horror game celebrating the era of early computing.

I'll be updating this game periodically, and with that, here are the patch notes for 1.5ca:


The game automatically saves for each official chapter you play.  When the game saves, a cute animated diskette shows up in the corner.
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45260050/180ea5d2f979b5c5fa98aae41e45e6233b0d5182.jpg
Removed Engine Intro.
UI Updated to match the aesthetic better


If any of you are bumping into any trouble in this update, feel free to send me a message through this link: 
https://cattrigger.com/links/

Thanks again, everyone!

~CatTrigger

notes.title: Storm the Swan - Update 1.4(a) - Happy Woods, Auto-Save Cards & More!
notes.content:
Storm the Swan - Update 1.4a


- HOT FIX: Fixed bug where Cursor can look glitched.
- Added more instruction for the HAPPY WOODS.
- A 'go-back-to-start' button is available when navigating the HAPPY WOODS.
- Readjusted when auto-save happens during Chapter Cards, so that the name of the Chapter shows up in the thumbnail of the auto-save.
- Added Bluesky link to the game, you can follow me there!

Thank you again for your continued support, everyone!  If there's anything amiss, please feel free to report any problems through the form at the BOTTOM of the page:
https://www.cattrigger.com/links


If you've enjoyed Storm the Swan, please leave a review on Steam!

I am now increasing developing of my main project 'Date Time' again, which has a new demo out this year.  I hope you enjoy it as much as 'Storm the Swan', please add 'Date Time' to your Steam Wishlist!

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45260050/5e6764052c619271250bfc58cdd8ff3c14726316.jpg

notes.title: Upcoming Storm Update, Date Time & THE BLUE SKY!
notes.content:
Hi everyone, it's been a while since I've talked about anything!

Look up into the BLUE SKY!

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45260050/2c1d7236c2916ed8649d6ea22dffa0ab5d2e022d.png

But before I talk about games, I'd like to announce that I have fully migrated from Twitter to Bluesky for my daily postings, including game development news / details, promotional materials, videos and miscellaneous art things I do like sketches and comics!

I'm enjoying it so far, and would love for y'all to join!  

Check my account here!


Storm's coming... for one more Major Update

We're about two months off from Storm the Swan's release, and I am about to put a lid on major updates for the game soon.  Here is what's coming down the pipeline for it:

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45260050/aea1f3c9d3a97bf1b66cb8d5c6624c2038f403b7.png

Mac Support for Steam Integration

Unfortunately, the Mac version of Storm the Swan will need some special treatment in order for Mac users to experience the full game with Steam Integration which includes Steam Achievements.  
This is due to the fact that the method I used does not work on M-grade CPUs.  My bad!  

This problem is tough to work through, as I do not own a Mac, and testing them have always fallen on beta testers to report back to me.  This will, unfortunately, be a time consuming process, so expect it to come in on a much later date.

Adding more help to the HAPPY WOODS!

A small portion of players have some difficulty navigating the HAPPY WOODS in the game, I am trying to implement an additional layer of instruction in order to help them along.
This update will come first before the Mac Steam Integration.  


{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45260050/5e6764052c619271250bfc58cdd8ff3c14726316.jpg

After the next update of Storm the Swan, I will be going back with more focus on Date Time, and will be giving more updates for that game as it continues production! 

I'd like to thank everyone who has played Storm the Swan, and would encourage you to please leave a review for the game on Steam, as it helps me with feedback AND discovery!

Thank you everyone for your support!

notes.title: STORM THE SWAN is finally out on STEAM for HALLOWEEN!
notes.content:
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43774152/8f361929197d8b613e132a76aa113d1eecc0c2e9.png

STORM THE SWAN is finally out on STEAM for HALLOWEEN!  It's FREE, so add it to your library!  

This version of the game is different from the current itch.io version in a few ways:


Implemented STEAM ACHIEVEMENTS, now you can officially wear them like a badge on your Steam account.  Can you get ALL OF THEM?!
Confirmed to be working on the Steam Deck.
Created a section for Content Warnings for 'Storm the Swan', the game is intended to be played without any knowledge of its content, however, if you do need to see a list of general content prior to playing, it is something you can view in the main menu.


For all the people who have played and enjoyed my game, it would be great if you leave a review on the Storm the Swan Steam page.  

Thank you everyone, I enjoyed making this game and hope to see you rack up those ACHIEVEMENTS!

https://store.steampowered.com/app/3275280/Storm_the_Swan__And_the_Power_of_FRIENDSHIP_and_IMAGINATION/
